feature: N06b: the default product's Bot model calls now run the unified admission — grants compile from committed Bot bindings, funding scopes come from the owner-configured accounts, and every call settles one receipt in the single SQLite authority

changes.grants: grantFor delegates to botSettings.grantFor(): an unconfigured, mismatched or incomplete binding grants no model authority; the settings catalog exposes the model-inference and mr-routing capabilities plus a local machine entry so an enabled binding is possible
changes.publication: onCommitted publishes the compiled grant to the directory immediately and onSuspended revokes it; a funding-account change re-evaluates every binding because the scope catalog follows it
changes.admission: bindingFunding maps the binding to the accounting policy (API pricing/request bounds/budgets plus the account limits, or subscription call quotas); the shared store is the SQLite authority; the accountStream switches from the diagnostic decorator to model-accounting
changes.vocabulary: The Bot runtime reports bot-session/bot-auxiliary origins; the receipt schema keeps its closed vocabulary, so the composition maps them explicitly and an unmapped origin fails closed
changes.frozenRequests: The SDK AgentLoop passes a frozen request whose signal cannot be replaced: the lease now gates the iteration so a quiet provider is still interrupted on revoke or expiry, and output clamping is required only when the request explicitly exceeds the configured allowance
